VEYL.MissingCardItem: The ability behind this card no longer exists.
VEYL.Hint.reserve: The defining discipline: while active it grants Attunement (derived from level, never stored) plus the Signature below, continuously, for as long as it is held.
VEYL.Hint.enhance: Rides its named trigger and reaches no further than the host action; it never stands alone. No more than one per action.
VEYL.Hint.active: A discrete effect with its own activation. A reaction with a named trigger is a Counter.
VEYL.Hint.climax: A single overwhelming effect, gained at 5th level. Spends the pool or the ready hand; Burnout or Winded follows.
VEYL.Hint.sentence: What your magic or art truly is, in one sentence
VEYL.Hint.trigger: e.g. when you take the Attack action
VEYL.Hint.signature: The continuous rule or condition of your design; always on while held.
VEYL.Hint.evolutions: The distinct additional effect gained when empowered across each tier threshold.
VEYL.Hint.deepenings: How the Signature or effect deepens at levels 10, 15, and 20.
VEYL.Reason.Burnout: Burned out: no Magecraft activations and no MP recovery until it ends.
VEYL.Reason.Strained: That comparable level is Strain-locked until a long rest.

VEYL.Reason.Level: The Surge is gained at 5th level.
